limitations: Static checks cover version boundaries; this revision did not rerun the full historical version matrix.
Native profiles in this revision are Paper only; no new Folia native run is claimed.
Basket native tests cover three IDs, six directions, water/enabled properties, actual redstone and same inventory/controller identity with component-bearing marker stacks.
Physical hopper transfer, normal player breaking/drop behavior, real chunk unload/reload and client visuals still require manual acceptance.
The skillet tray regression does not replace a separate cooking-pot placement test.
Fence client visuals and model collision outline must be checked with the real resource pack.
No performance benchmark or comparative server run was performed.
Remaining mod-alignment work is described in the private local implementation plan.
